subject: Post-call: pilot alignment, success guardrails, and platform access
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@blueframe.ai>, Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@blueframe.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot outline

Thanks for the time earlier — great discussion. Quick recap from our call and a proposed scope for a short pilot so we can validate impact quickly. Please flag anything we mis-stated.

Summary of main pain points you shared:
- High tail latency on model responses (spiky p95 during peak inference windows).
- Per-request costs are unpredictable and high on current infra.
- Domain-specific hallucinations on Q&A and document parsing, affecting trust in automation.
- Hard requirement for stronger control over data (encryption, audit logs) for regulated customers.

Business goals you emphasized:
- Bring p95 inference latency below ~250ms for the bulk of production traffic.
- Reduce unit cost per inference by ~50–60% vs current baseline.
- Raise QA pass rate on our domain evaluation set to >=90% (reduce critical hallucinations).

Proposed 4-week pilot (high level):
- Scope: 10k queries/day sample traffic, 150 seed prompts for eval, small holdout set for regression checks.
- Success metrics: p95 latency, median cost per request, eval accuracy (golden-set pass rate), and regression rate on prompt suite.
- Owners: Hannah (engagement lead / CSM), Ben (solutions / infra), Rishi (security & compliance).
- Timeline:
  Week 0 (this week): account access, infra & data onboarding.
  Week 1: baseline measurements and model variant smoke test.
  Week 2: optimization (batching, cache, light quantization variants).
  Week 3: prompt/eval runs & quality tuning.
  Week 4: acceptance, handoff and next-steps discussion.

Access / setup asks (what we need from Blueframe):
- Allowlist IPs and one admin API key for Redwood test agent.
- Short S3 bucket or secure share with a sample of ~2k de-identified prompts and expected outputs.
- If you prefer VPC peering or a VPN, let us know and we can share the network guide.
- Confirmation of KMS preference (customer-managed keys) if required for the pilot.

Attachments: pilot-charter-v1.pdf (charter + acceptance criteria), prompt-set.csv (seed prompts).

Next steps: can we lock access items by end of this week? Would Monday morning (26 Jul) for an ops kickoff work for you?

Thanks — excited to run this with you.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@blueframe.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@blueframe.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot outline

Thanks, Hannah — this is very helpful and aligns with what we heard on our side. A few clarifications / asks: 

- Data residency / encryption: we have EU customers and need clear options for encryption at rest and CMK (customer-managed keys). Can you confirm Redwood supports KMS/HSM integration for the pilot?
- Hallucination testing: we'd like an earlier run specifically targeted at the 25 golden cases we track internally — if we can surface failures by week 1 that would be ideal. I've attached the list (golden-prompts.xlsx).
- Timeline: Monday the 26th for an ops kickoff is fine. Can we shorten the baseline window to 3 days (week 1) and then iterate quicker?

One more operational note: can Redwood provide an IP allowlist and a single endpoint for our staging data? We'll open a ticket with infra once we confirm the hostnames.

Onboarding action: attaching golden-prompts.xlsx for the pilot prompt/eval set.

Thanks,
Ethan
Head of ML Ops
Blueframe Analytics

Subject: Pilot kickoff recap + action items (updated)

Appreciate the quick reply, Ethan — good notes. Below is an updated kickoff recap that incorporates the KMS and golden-prompt asks and shortens the baseline window per your request.

What Redwood will deliver for the pilot:
- KMS integration: we support both customer-managed keys (AWS KMS or equivalent) and HSM-backed keys for the Private deployment option. Roadmap: KMS config + test by Day 2 of onboarding.
- Encryption & logs: all traffic TLS, audit logs exported to your secure S3 (optionally to your SIEM).
- Early hallucination run: we will run the 25 golden cases within 72 hours of ingestion and share per-case signal (pass/fail + raw outputs).

Revised timeline (compressed baseline):
- Day 0 (ops kickoff, Mon 26 Jul): exchange keys, allowlist, and access checklist.
- Days 1–3 (baseline): ingest sample traffic + run golden-case smoke tests.
- Days 4–10 (optimize): iter variants, batching, prompt tweaks.
- Days 11–17 (eval): full prompt suite + holdout regression checks.
- Day 18–21 (accept & handoff): results deck and next-steps.

Owners & immediate action items:
- Blueframe (Ethan / Maya): share allowlist IPs, S3 sample location, and confirm KMS choice (due Fri 24 Jul).
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff recap + action items (updated)

Looping in internal ops notes for the pilot: 
- I'll size a 2x-A100-equivalent pool for the first two weeks to ensure headroom during baseline runs; we can dial down if steady-state looks good.
- Suggest starting model variant: gpt-j-8b-quantized (low-latency profile) and run a small comparision against the 16-bit fp variant for quality.
- I'll prepare an access-checklist.md and share a short runbook for model deploy + fallback (will attach to the HubSpot deal record).

Ben
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
